001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Synchronous dose start (AIQ / AIDANET algorithm).
009 */
010
011/**
012 * History log record Sync Dose Start, opCode 558, size 26.
013 *
014 * <br>
015 *
016 * Synchronous dose start (AIQ / AIDANET algorithm).
017 *
018 * 
019 * <table border='1'>
020 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
021 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>558</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
022 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Sync Dose Start"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
023 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_SYNC_DOSE_START"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
024 * </table>
025 */@HistoryLogProps(
026    opCode = 558,
027    displayName = "Sync Dose Start",
028    internalName = "LID_SYNC_DOSE_START"
029)
030public class SyncDoseStartHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
031
032    private int doseId;
033    private int doseSource;
034    private int tempAdjustmentPercent;
035    private float syncDoseSizeRequested;
036    private int currentBasalRate;
037    private int profileBasalRate;
038    private float activeInsulin;
039
040    public SyncDoseStartHistoryLog() {}
041    public SyncDoseStartHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
042        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
043    }
044
045    public SyncDoseStartHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int doseId, int doseSource, int tempAdjustmentPercent, float syncDoseSizeRequested, int currentBasalRate, int profileBasalRate, float activeInsulin) {
046        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
047        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, doseId, doseSource, tempAdjustmentPercent, syncDoseSizeRequested, currentBasalRate, profileBasalRate, activeInsulin);
048        parse(cargo);
049    }
050
051    public SyncDoseStartHistoryLog(int doseId, int doseSource, int tempAdjustmentPercent, float syncDoseSizeRequested, int currentBasalRate, int profileBasalRate, float activeInsulin) {
052        this(0, 0, doseId, doseSource, tempAdjustmentPercent, syncDoseSizeRequested, currentBasalRate, profileBasalRate, activeInsulin);
053    }
054
055    public int typeId() {
056        return 558;
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * <table border="1">
061     * <caption>Parsed fields for SyncDoseStartHistoryLog:</caption>
062     * <tr><td><code>doseId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>doseSource</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>tempAdjustmentPercent</code></td><td><code>raw[13] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>syncDoseSizeRequested</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>currentBasalRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>profileBasalRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>activeInsulin</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
069     * </table>
070     */
071    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
072        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
073        this.cargo = raw;
074        parseBase(raw);
075        this.doseId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
076        this.doseSource = raw[12] & 0xFF;
077        this.tempAdjustmentPercent = raw[13] & 0xFF;
078        this.syncDoseSizeRequested = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
079        this.currentBasalRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
080        this.profileBasalRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
081        this.activeInsulin = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22);
082    }
083
084    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
085        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
086    }
087
088    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int doseId, int doseSource, int tempAdjustmentPercent, float syncDoseSizeRequested, int currentBasalRate, int profileBasalRate, float activeInsulin) {
089        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
090            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(558, 0),
091            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
092            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(doseId),
094            new byte[]{(byte) doseSource},
095            new byte[]{(byte) tempAdjustmentPercent},
096            Bytes.toFloat(syncDoseSizeRequested),
097            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentBasalRate),
098            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(profileBasalRate),
099            Bytes.toFloat(activeInsulin)));
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * @return the dose ID
104     */
105    public int getDoseId() {
106        return doseId;
107    }
108    /**
109     * @return raw dose source, see {@link DoseSource}
110     */
111    public int getDoseSource() {
112        return doseSource;
113    }
114    public DoseSource getDoseSourceEnum() {
115        return DoseSource.fromId(doseSource);
116    }
117    /**
118     * @return temporary adjustment percent (100 = 100%)
119     */
120    public int getTempAdjustmentPercent() {
121        return tempAdjustmentPercent;
122    }
123    /**
124     * @return requested dose size, in units
125     */
126    public float getSyncDoseSizeRequested() {
127        return syncDoseSizeRequested;
128    }
129    /**
130     * @return current basal rate, in milliunits/hr
131     */
132    public int getCurrentBasalRate() {
133        return currentBasalRate;
134    }
135    /**
136     * @return profile basal rate, in milliunits/hr
137     */
138    public int getProfileBasalRate() {
139        return profileBasalRate;
140    }
141    /**
142     * @return active insulin (IOB), in units
143     */
144    public float getActiveInsulin() {
145        return activeInsulin;
146    }
147
148    public enum DoseSource {
149        SUSPENDED(0),
150        PROFILE(1),
151        PROFILE_AND_TEMP_RATE(2),
152        ALGORITHM(3),
153        ALGORITHM_AND_TEMP_CONTROL_RATE(4)
154
155        ;
156        private final int id;
157        DoseSource(int id) {
158            this.id = id;
159        }
160
161        public static DoseSource fromId(int id) {
162            for (DoseSource r : values()) {
163                if (r.id == id) {
164                    return r;
165                }
166            }
167            return null;
168        }
169
170        public int getId() {
171            return id;
172        }
173    }
174}
